input.command:
OUTDIR="$HOME/Desktop/id_bank_pdf_work"
# Fix orientation: another 180°
sips -r 180 "$OUTDIR/id_rotated.jpg" --out "$OUTDIR/id_upright.jpg"
sips -g pixelWidth -g pixelHeight "$OUTDIR/id_upright.jpg"

# Create PDF with Swift (AppKit) — Chinese text + images
cat > "$OUTDIR/make_pdf.swift" << 'SWIFT'
import AppKit
import Foundation

let outDir = NSString(string: "~/Desktop/id_bank_pdf_work").expandingTildeInPath
let idPath = outDir + "/id_upright.jpg"
let bankPath = outDir + "/bank_card.jpg"
let pdfPath = NSString(string: "~/Desktop/身份证银行卡信息.pdf").expandingTildeInPath

guard let idImg = NSImage(contentsOfFile: idPath),
      let bankImg = NSImage(contentsOfFile: bankPath) else {
    fputs("failed to load images\n", stderr)
    exit(1)
}

let pageWidth: CGFloat = 595.0   // A4
let pageHeight: CGFloat = 842.0
let margin: CGFloat = 36.0
let contentWidth = pageWidth - margin * 2

func drawFittedImage(_ image: NSImage, in rect: NSRect) {
    let imgSize = image.size
    guard imgSize.width > 0 && imgSize.height > 0 else { return }
    let scale = min(rect.width / imgSize.width, rect.height / imgSize.height)
    let w = imgSize.width * scale
    let h = imgSize.height * scale
    let x = rect.origin.x + (rect.width - w) / 2
    let y = rect.origin.y + (rect.height - h) / 2
    image.draw(in: NSRect(x: x, y: y, width: w, height: h),
               from: .zero,
               operation: .sourceOver,
               fraction: 1.0)
}

let infoLines = [
    "卡号：6216608100005795695",
    "户名：闫泽群",
    "开户行：中国银行交城支行营业部"
]

let font = NSFont(name: "PingFangSC-Regular", size: 16)
    ?? NSFont(name: "STHeitiSC-Light", size: 16)
    ?? NSFont.systemFont(ofSize: 16)
let titleFont = NSFont(name: "PingFangSC-Semibold", size: 20)
    ?? NSFont(name: "STHeitiSC-Medium", size: 20)
    ?? NSFont.boldSystemFont(ofSize: 20)

let attrs: [NSAttributedString.Key: Any] = [
    .font: font,
    .foregroundColor: NSColor.black
]
let titleAttrs: [NSAttributedString.Key: Any] = [
    .font: titleFont,
    .foregroundColor: NSColor.black
]

var mediaBox = CGRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: pageWidth, height: pageHeight)
guard let consumer = CGDataConsumer(url: URL(fileURLWithPath: pdfPath) as CFURL),
      let ctx = CGContext(consumer: consumer, mediaBox: &mediaBox, nil) else {
    fputs("failed to create PDF context\n", stderr)
    exit(1)
}

let nsCtx = NSGraphicsContext(cgContext: ctx, flipped: false)
NSGraphicsContext.current = nsCtx

ctx.beginPDFPage(nil)
ctx.setFillColor(NSColor.white.cgColor)
ctx.fill(mediaBox)

// Title
let title = NSAttributedString(string: "身份证与银行卡信息", attributes: titleAttrs)
let titleSize = title.size()
title.draw(at: NSPoint(x: (pageWidth - titleSize.width) / 2, y: pageHeight - margin - titleSize.height))

var y = pageHeight - margin - titleSize.height - 20

// ID label
let idLabel = NSAttributedString(string: "一、身份证", attributes: attrs)
idLabel.draw(at: NSPoint(x: margin, y: y - 18))
y -= 28

// ID image area
let idAreaH: CGFloat = 220
drawFittedImage(idImg, in: NSRect(x: margin, y: y - idAreaH, width: contentWidth, height: idAreaH))
y -= idAreaH + 24

// Bank label
let bankLabel = NSAttributedString(string: "二、银行卡", attributes: attrs)
bankLabel.draw(at: NSPoint(x: margin, y: y - 18))
y -= 28

let bankAreaH: CGFloat = 200
drawFittedImage(bankImg, in: NSRect(x: margin, y: y - bankAreaH, width: contentWidth, height: bankAreaH))
y -= bankAreaH + 28

// Info section
let infoTitle = NSAttributedString(string: "三、账户信息", attributes: attrs)
infoTitle.draw(at: NSPoint(x: margin, y: y - 18))
y -= 36

for line in infoLines {
    let s = NSAttributedString(string: line, attributes: attrs)
    s.draw(at: NSPoint(x: margin + 12, y: y - 18))
    y -= 28
}

ctx.endPDFPage()
ctx.closePDF()
print(pdfPath)
SWIFT

swift "$OUTDIR/make_pdf.swift"

func loadOrientedImage(_ path: String) -> NSImage? {
    let url = URL(fileURLWithPath: path) as CFURL
    guard let src = CGImageSourceCreateWithURL(url, nil),
          let cg = CGImageSourceCreateImageAtIndex(src, 0, [kCGImageSourceShouldCache: true] as CFDictionary) else {
        return NSImage(contentsOfFile: path)
    }
    let w = cg.width
    let h = cg.height
    return NSImage(cgImage: cg, size: NSSize(width: w, height: h))
